purpose: Synthetic transcripts for the title-selection probe. Every word here was invented for this file: no meeting recording, Preview datum, or product record appears in it. Both arms read this one file, which is why it carries their expectations rather than either implementation carrying its own copy.
control_turn: The turn `meeting_title::derived_title` picks — the first non-gated turn whose opening sentence runs to at least MIN_TITLE_WORDS words. It is asserted by a Rust test against the real function, so a wrong value here fails the build rather than quietly redefining the baseline.
intended_turn: The turn that names the meeting, in the judgment of whoever wrote the fixture, recorded before any model ran. Agreement with it is a selection measurement and not a usefulness claim; no mechanical result can make a title worth reading. Null means no turn names the meeting and the model is expected to abstain.
shape: The identifying turn sits at a different position in each fixture, deliberately. A first draft had it second-from-the-start in five of ten cases and last in five, so 'always take the second offered turn' scored 6 of 10 and 'always take the last' scored 5 — a suite a model could pass without reading anything. `test_no_degenerate_position_rule_scores_well` now pins that, and it is the reason several fixtures carry a turn after the identifying one.

fixtures.name: agenda-after-logistics
fixtures.why: The screen check clears the word bar and identifies nothing. The turn after it states the decision.

fixtures.name: two-topics
fixtures.why: Two subjects are named. The first is the one a person would title the meeting with, and the fixture asserts that rather than accepting either.

fixtures.name: no-agenda-abstain
fixtures.why: Nothing said here identifies a meeting. The registered answer is abstention, and the deterministic rule then names it.

fixtures.name: numbers-and-names
fixtures.why: The identifying turn carries a name and two numerals. Selection returns an index, so nothing here can be mis-transcribed — which is the point of the design and is recorded as such.

fixtures.name: withheld-first

fixtures.why: The identifying turn's opening sentence exceeds the 120-scalar ceiling, so the selected turn still has to survive the same cleaning and cut as any other.
